issues.legal_issue: A first appellate court’s failure to frame separate points for determination does not invalidate its judgment if it substantially complies with Order 41 Rule 31 CPC by addressing the issues arising in the appeal and giving reasoned findings.
A plot owner who accepts a smaller reconstituted plot and the scheme’s compensation without protest cannot later challenge the reduced allotment or seek additional compensation.
A Town Planning Scheme may be varied under Section 71 to reconstitute plots and reduce a previously allotted plot’s area.
A plot owner who surrenders land under a Town Planning Scheme has no guaranteed right to receive a replacement plot, or one of equal area.
A claim for quantified compensation or damages for loss relating to land under a Town Planning Scheme must be supported by evidence establishing the relevant land values.
A challenge to compensation determined by the Town Planning Officer under Section 52(3)(x) must be brought through the statutory appeal under Section 54.
